main_text.head: 26. Cum Rex in Holmbeja interciperetur, & quæ inde distractiones in Utraque Domo, Exercitu & Urbe consecutæ.
main_text.p: QVam Personam mihi jam impositurus est Deus, vel quid agere omnino aut pati velit in hac Nova rerum Scena haud sum valdè sollicitus. Modico usu Artifex evadet qui Honestatis tantum & Virtutis partes susceperit.
Hac Mei raptione ostendunt, vix eo usque dejici Regem posse, ut non momentum sit aliquod & Pondus, parti in qua conspicitur, al-laturus.
Motus iste (prout alii horum Temporum) Eccentricus prorsus & Irregularis, cui tamen haud facile vel resistat quispiam, vel fistat. Præstat rapi torrente, quàm frustra brachio contra obniti. Nempe

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "follicitus" printed without a second l, kept as printed. The initial letter of the first word and the first letter of the page are read as printed. Changed for convention: Vtraque to Utraque, Vrbe to Urbe, Vtraque in the heading, Personam to Personam, est to est, sum to sum, vsu to usu, vsque to usque, susceperit to susceperit, refistat to resistat, Honestatis to Honestatis, Virtutis, Eccentricus and fistat (long s to plain s). Italic: Nova, Scena, Honestatis, Virtutis, Eccentricus, fistat are italic as printed; the italic status of Scena is uncertain. The paragraph beginning "Nempe" continues beyond this page.
